NIF.SLSF1.bit0.reason: SLSF1_Specular (bit 0) gates KHR_materials_specular in converter and enables specular in skin_material.rs and retail::apply.

NIF.SLSF1.bit1.reason: SLSF1 bit 1 (Skinned) is preserved in glTF extras/extension shaderFlags1 but never read (skinning uses BSTriShape.skin; FaceGen/SkinTint use ShaderType; terrain uses ESM LAND; MODS uses ObjectGeometryIndex).

NIF.SLSF1.bit10.reason: SLSF1 bit 10 (Facegen_Detail_Map): the engine reads it. Under skyrim it ranks the face technique (SPEC-1 section 9.1), which gates the face inputs of a surface. The inputs themselves still come from the NIF shader type, and mudcrab does not read the flag.

NIF.SLSF1.bit11.reason: SLSF1 bit 11 (Parallax): the engine reads it. Under skyrim it selects the parallax technique, which binds the height map and takes the one-step offset of SPEC-1 sections 9.1 and 9.2. mudcrab does not read it.

NIF.SLSF1.bit12.reason: SLSF1_Model_Space_Normals (bit 12) routes normal maps through SkyrimSkinMaterial and cs_lighting_msn model-space normal decode.

NIF.SLSF1.bit13.reason: SLSF1 bit 13 (Non_Projective_Shadows) is preserved in shaderFlags1 metadata, but the corresponding shader/render feature is not implemented in engine.

NIF.SLSF1.bit14.reason: SLSF1 bit 14 (Landscape): the engine reads it to rank the landscape technique over the other NIF techniques. A NIF surface takes no landscape shading from it; terrain comes from LAND records.

evidence.anchor: Self::Refraction => "STAND-IN(#362): a refraction effect surface draws as a surface",

NIF.SLSF1.bit15.reason: The engine reads it. SLSF1 bit 15 (Refraction): the skyrim profile draws no lit pass for a refraction surface, a refraction effect surface draws as a surface (Open::Refraction), and screen-space refraction distortion is not implemented.

NIF.SLSF1.bit16.reason: SLSF1_Fire_Refraction (bit 16) is excluded/hidden by converter (material.rs:846-850) because fire refraction distortion rendering is not implemented.

NIF.SLSF1.bit17.reason: SLSF1 bit 17 (Eye_Environment_Mapping): the engine reads it only to rank the eye technique over the other techniques. Eye shading is not implemented (#490, #1082).

NIF.SLSF1.bit18.reason: SLSF1_Hair_Soft_Lighting (bit 18) triggers SkyrimSkinFlags::HAIR_DECAL alpha handling when paired with Decal and ZBuffer_Write under skyrim profile, while hair soft-lighting BRDF shading is not implemented.

NIF.SLSF1.bit19.reason: SLSF1_Screendoor_Alpha_Fade (bit 19) is preserved in OPEN_SKYRIM_material.screenDoorAlphaFade, but screendoor dither alpha fade is not implemented in engine.

evidence.anchor: Self::Refraction => "STAND-IN(#362): a refraction effect surface draws as a surface",

NIF.SLSF1.bit20.reason: SLSF1 bit 20: the engine reads it. Under skyrim the surface takes a black base map (SPEC-1 section 5); the nif.xml name of the bit differs. mudcrab does not read it.

NIF.SLSF1.bit21.reason: SLSF1 bit 21 (FaceGen_RGB_Tint): the engine reads it. Under skyrim it ranks the face tint technique (SPEC-1 section 9.1), which gates the tint inputs of a surface. The inputs themselves still come from the NIF shader type, and mudcrab does not read the flag.

NIF.SLSF1.bit22.reason: SLSF1_Own_Emit (bit 22) gates emission in retail::apply (skyrim profile) and diffuse-modulated emission in nif_material.rs:614, but converter material.rs:654 exports emissiveFactor unconditionally so mudcrab profile still emits without bit 22.
